# CWE-326: Inadequate Encryption Strength — Detection in IaC Scripts

## Core Weaknesses to Detect

### 1. Weak or Deprecated Encryption Algorithm Specification
Look for explicit reference to broken or outdated cryptographic algorithms in configuration fields.

**Keywords/Attributes/Fields:**
- `algorithm`, `encryption_algorithm`, `cipher`, `cipher_suite`, `key_algorithm`, `key_spec`
- Weak values: `DES`, `3DES`, `RC4`, `RC2`, `MD5`, `SHA1`, `SHA-1`, `Blowfish`, `NULL`, `EXPORT`, `ANON`, `AES-128` (context-dependent)

---

### 2. Insufficient Key Length / Key Size
Short cryptographic key sizes allow brute force attacks within feasible timeframes.

**Keywords/Attributes/Fields:**
- `key_size`, `key_length`, `key_bits`, `rsa_bits`, `key_strength`, `bit_length`
- Weak values for asymmetric keys: `512`, `768`, `1024` (RSA/DSA below 2048)
- Weak values for symmetric keys: `56`, `64`, `112` (DES/3DES-range)

---

### 3. Weak TLS/SSL Protocol Version Acceptance
Allowing outdated protocol versions exposes sessions to known attacks (e.g., BEAST, POODLE, DROWN).

**Keywords/Attributes/Fields:**
- `ssl_policy`, `tls_policy`, `security_policy`, `minimum_tls_version`, `min_tls_version`, `ssl_protocols`, `tls_version`
- `tls_1_0_enabled`, `tls_1_1_enabled`, `ssl_v2_enabled`, `ssl_v3_enabled`
- Weak values: `SSLv2`, `SSLv3`, `TLSv1`, `TLSv1.0`, `TLS_1_0`, `TLS_1_1`, `TLSv1.1`

---

### 4. Weak Cipher Suite Allowance
Permitting export-grade, null, or anonymous cipher suites degrades effective encryption strength.

**Keywords/Attributes/Fields:**
- `cipher_suites`, `allowed_ciphers`, `enabled_cipher_suites`, `ciphers`
- Weak values/patterns: `_RC4_`, `_DES_`, `_3DES_`, `_NULL_`, `_EXPORT_`, `_ANON_`, `_MD5`, `_SHA` (without numeric suffix)

---

### 5. Weak Diffie-Hellman (DH) / Key Exchange Parameters
Low-order DH groups weaken forward secrecy and key establishment.

**Keywords/Attributes/Fields:**
- `dh_group`, `dh_group_numbers`, `pfs_group`, `key_exchange`, `ike_version`
- `phase1_encryption_algorithms`, `phase2_encryption_algorithms`
- Weak values: `group1`, `group2`, `group5`, `modp768`, `modp1024`, `DHE-768`, `DHE-1024`

---

### 6. Weak Storage / At-Rest Encryption Specification
Specifying a weak algorithm for disk, database, or object encryption.

**Keywords/Attributes/Fields:**
- `sse_algorithm`, `server_side_encryption`, `encryption_type`, `storage_encrypted`, `encrypted`
- `kms_key_id` — absence may imply platform default (potentially weak)
- Weak values: `AES128`, `AES-128`, `DES`, `3DES`, any non-standard or custom scheme

---

### 7. Weak Certificate Signature Algorithm
Certificates signed with broken hash algorithms reduce the assurance of the entire trust chain.

**Keywords/Attributes/Fields:**
- `signature_algorithm`, `certificate_algorithm`, `signing_algorithm`
- Weak values: `sha1WithRSAEncryption`, `md5WithRSAEncryption`, `SHA1`, `MD5`

---

### 8. Absence of Encryption or Fallback to Plaintext/Default
When encryption is optional or defaulted, weak or no encryption may be in effect.

**Keywords/Attributes/Fields:**
- `encryption_enabled`, `in_transit_encryption`, `at_rest_encryption` — set to `false` or absent
- `require_ssl`, `enforce_https`, `secure` — set to `false`
- `transit_encryption_mode` — set to `DISABLED` or similar

---

## Summary Table

| Weakness Category | Key Indicators | Dangerous Values |
|---|---|---|
| Weak Algorithm | `algorithm`, `cipher`, `key_spec` | `DES`, `RC4`, `MD5`, `SHA1` |
| Short Key Length | `key_size`, `rsa_bits`, `key_bits` | `< 2048` (asymmetric), `< 128` (symmetric) |
| Weak TLS Version | `min_tls_version`, `ssl_policy` | `TLSv1.0`, `TLSv1.1`, `SSLv3` |
| Weak Cipher Suites | `cipher_suites`, `ciphers` | `_RC4_`, `_NULL_`, `_EXPORT_` |
| Weak DH Parameters | `dh_group`, `pfs_group` | `group2`, `group5`, `modp1024` |
| Weak At-Rest Encryption | `sse_algorithm`, `encryption_type` | `AES128`, `DES`, absent KMS key |
| Weak Certificate Signing | `signature_algorithm` | `SHA1`, `MD5` variants |
| Encryption Disabled | `encryption_enabled`, `require_ssl` | `false`, `DISABLED`, absent |

package glitch

import data.glitch_lib

weak_algo_attrs := {
    "algorithm", "encryption_algorithm", "cipher", "cipher_suite",
    "key_algorithm", "key_spec", "sse_algorithm", "server_side_encryption",
    "encryption_type", "signature_algorithm", "certificate_algorithm", "signing_algorithm"
}

key_size_attrs := {
    "key_size", "key_length", "key_bits", "key_strength", "bit_length"
}

weak_tls_string_attrs := {
    "ssl_policy", "tls_policy", "security_policy", "minimum_tls_version",
    "min_tls_version", "ssl_protocols", "tls_version"
}

weak_tls_bool_attrs := {
    "tls_1_0_enabled", "tls_1_1_enabled", "ssl_v2_enabled", "ssl_v3_enabled"
}

weak_cipher_attrs := {
    "cipher_suites", "allowed_ciphers", "enabled_cipher_suites", "ciphers"
}

dh_attrs := {
    "dh_group", "dh_group_numbers", "pfs_group",
    "phase1_encryption_algorithms", "phase2_encryption_algorithms"
}

encryption_flag_attrs := {
    "encryption_enabled", "in_transit_encryption", "at_rest_encryption",
    "require_ssl", "enforce_https", "secure"
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == weak_algo_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)^(DES|3DES|RC4|RC2|MD5|SHA1|SHA-1|sha1WithRSAEncryption|md5WithRSAEncryption|Blowfish|NULL|EXPORT|ANON)$", attr.value.value)
    glitch_lib.traverse_var(attr.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Weak or deprecated encryption algorithm specified. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == "rsa_bits"

    attr.value.value < 2048

    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - RSA key size below 2048 bits is insufficient. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == key_size_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Integer"
    attr.value.value > 0
    attr.value.value <= 1024
    glitch_lib.traverse_var(attr.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Key size is insufficient for strong encryption. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == weak_tls_string_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)(SSLv[23]|TLSv?1\\.0|TLSv?1\\.1|TLS[_-]1[_-][01]|^TLSv?1$)", attr.value.value)
    glitch_lib.traverse_var(attr.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Weak TLS/SSL protocol version is allowed. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == weak_tls_bool_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == true
    glitch_lib.traverse_var(attr.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Weak TLS/SSL protocol version is enabled. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == weak_cipher_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)(_RC4_|_DES_|_3DES_|_NULL_|_EXPORT_|_ANON_|_MD5([^0-9]|$)|_SHA([^0-9]|$))", attr.value.value)
    glitch_lib.traverse_var(attr.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Weak cipher suite specified. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == dh_attrs[_]

    glitch_lib.traverse_var(attr.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Weak Diffie-Hellman key exchange parameters. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == encryption_flag_attrs[_]
    attr.value.ir_type == "Boolean"
    attr.value.value == false
    glitch_lib.traverse_var(attr.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Encryption is disabled or not enforced. (CWE-326)"
    }
}

Glitch_Analysis[result] {
    parent := glitch_lib._gather_parent_unit_blocks[_]
    parent.path != ""
    attrs := glitch_lib.all_attributes(parent)
    attr := attrs[_]
    attr.name == "transit_encryption_mode"
    attr.value.ir_type == "String"
    regex.match("(?i)^DISABLED$", attr.value.value)
    glitch_lib.traverse_var(attr.value)
    result := {
        "type": "sec_weak_crypt",
        "element": attr,
        "path": parent.path,
        "description": "Inadequate Encryption Strength - Transit encryption is disabled. (CWE-326)"
    }
}
